You will not have the same protections afforded to stockholders of companies that are subject to such requirements. &#8203; &#8226; There can be no assurance that we will be able to make or maintain cash distributions, monthly or otherwise, and certain agreements relating to our indebtedness may, under certain circumstances, limit or eliminate our ability to make distributions to holders of our Class A-1 common stock. &#8203; &#8226; Our unaudited pro forma combined and consolidated financial information included elsewhere in this prospectus are presented for informational purposes only; do not purport to represent what our results of operations or financial condition would actually have been had the adjustments described in the unaudited pro forma combined and consolidated financial information occurred on the dates indicated; and do not purport to be indicative of our future results of operations or our financial condition. &#8203; Structure and Formation of Our Company In connection with our initial public offering, we consummated a series of transactions referred to herein as our &#8220;formation transactions&#8221; through which we adopted our charter, which recapitalized our common stock, and Healthpeak transferred, directly or indirectly, the real estate assets that comprised our initial portfolio to us. As a result of these transactions, Healthpeak received 138,816,246 shares of our Class A-1 common stock and 75,917,780 common units, which collectively had a value of $4.3 billion (based on the initial public offering price in our initial public offering). In addition, Healthpeak purchased 75,917,780 shares of Class A-2 common stock, an amount equivalent to the common units Healthpeak held upon completion of the formation transactions described above, for aggregate consideration of approximately $760,000. Substantially all of our assets are held by, and substantially all of our operations are conducted through, our operating company, either directly or through its subsidiaries. We are the sole managing member of our operating company. We intend to contribute the net proceeds from this offering to our operating company and receive 16,000,000 common units (or 18,400,000 common units if the underwriters exercise their option to purchase up to an additional 2,400,000 shares of our Class A-1 common stock in full), assuming the number of shares offered by us as set forth on the front cover of this prospectus remains the same. Following the offering, we will own a 75.3% ownership interest in the operating company (or 75.5% if the underwriters exercise their option to purchase additional shares of our Class A-1 common stock in full), with Healthpeak holding a 24.6% ownership interest in the operating company (or 24.5% if the underwriters exercise their option to purchase additional shares of our Class A-1 common stock in full), in each case assuming the number of shares offered by us as set forth on the front cover of this prospectus remains the same. See &#8220;Structure and Formation of Our Company.&#8221; Class A-1 Common Stock, Class A-2 Common Stock and Common Units We have two classes of common stock: Class A-1 common stock and Class A-2 common stock. Our Class A-1 common stock has both voting and economic rights. Our Class A-2 common stock is held by, and will be issued only to, Healthpeak in a number equal to the common units it owns in our operating company.
